description: Fetch one publicly visible conference by its URL slug — dates, timezone, venue, organizer, program status, and the link to its public page. Needs no credentials. Use it once you have a slug, to answer detail questions about a specific conference; get the slug from list_public_conferences first. Returns an error for a conference that is draft, archived, or restricted to members.

slug.description: The conference's URL slug, as it appears in /events/<slug> and in list_public_conferences.

name: get_public_conference
title: Get one public conference
